question: Which novel earned Percival Everett the Pulitzer Prize for Fiction in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is **__James__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Percival Everett won the 2025 Pulitzer Prize for Fiction for his novel James. 
 
• James is a re-imagining of Mark Twain’s The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn, told from the perspective of Jim, the enslaved character, giving him agency and a new narrative focus. 
 
• The novel also won major literary awards including the National Book Award and the Kirkus Prize before the Pulitzer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Erasure**

 
 
• Novel by Percival Everett that was adapted into the Oscar-winning film American Fiction (2023).
 
 
 
• **The Trees**
 
 
• Everett’s novel that was shortlisted for the Booker Prize (2021) and Pulitzer finalist in 2022. 
 
• Themes include history, race, and violence in the American South.
